description: A real Intel Mac client answering a live psistorm challenge: Mac Diablo II 1.14.3.71 (platform XMAC, product D2DV, verbyte 0x0E) on Mac OS X 10.13.6, connected to useast.battle.net, 2026-10-09. The raw CD-key part of the SID_AUTH_CHECK packet is not included.

answer.server_reply: 0x51 result 0x100 old game version, patch offered + D2DV_XMAC_1xx_114d.mpq

files_not_hashed: The XMAC library ignores its file arguments (the client passes a path and two empty buffers). It hashes the main bundle's executable only.
notes: Server side (2026-10-09): useast answered 0x100 (old game version) + D2DV_XMAC_1xx_114d.mpq to this answer from the CURRENT client (1.14.3.71), the only one of four such answers that failed. psistorm_template.c, psistorm_ref.py and the real library all produce exactly this answer: it is what the client computes.

The exe_info here is 15 bytes, not 16 (the digest shuffle's base-255 output had a leading zero digit); the client sent the 15 bytes followed by the NUL and the key owner. All other sessions had 16 bytes. Whether the server mishandles a 15-byte exe_info, or numeral 17, is not established (one sample).
